snippet.title: City Town - DLC Date Reveal - Hello Kitty Island Adventure
snippet.description:
Landing soon on April 16th! Usahana is coming to Hello Kitty Island Adventure in City Town, a rainbow metropolis teeming with creativity and mystery. Run your own personalized Cafe, complete quests to bring dreams to life, master new minigames, and let your imagination run wild!. 

Coming to Hello Kitty Island Adventure on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, and PS5 on April 16th.
